name: Runner Extras - TestPage enum-backed fields
brief: Pins that TestPage SetValue/Value resolve members of an Enum-backed table field, not just of an Option field declared with OptionMembers.
description: AL has two ways to spell the same thing. `field(2; Kind; Option) { OptionMembers = Alpha,Beta; }` carries its members on the field itself; `field(3; Grade; Enum "TEF Grade")` carries an id and keeps the members in a separate enum object. Both are Option-typed to the runtime, and a TestPage drives both by member name. A runner that only reads members off the field answers every Option test correctly and fails every Enum one with 'The value "High" can't be evaluated into type Option' — an error that names the value and the type but not the reason, so it reads as a bad test rather than as missing metadata.
